Retained actual immutable source and final native ELF/bin from rw-constant-pools, 2026-10-08.
Four const float[2] definitions total 32 bytes; the second producer also contains three existing scalar floats (12 bytes).
ELF symbol types/sizes and bytes are preserved, never rewritten. Fixtures replay source sizing and ordinary native producer admission; no native process is run.
The manifest pins the retained file paths and uncompressed SHA256 values. ROM bytes are limited to these exact 24- and 20-byte outputs.
